item.description:
What's new in 1.1.1

  • Signed with a Developer ID and notarized by Apple. The security warning on first launch is gone: no trip to System Settings, no "Apple could not verify…". You will be asked for screen recording and accessibility once more after this update — the app's identity changed from a self-made certificate to a real one, and macOS ties permissions to that identity.
  • Share a screenshot or a recording straight from the history, and Cueshot itself from the menu.
  • Anonymous usage counts now actually record what they promised to: which features get used, where setup breaks off, which errors occur. Still off until you say yes, still never any content.
